```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## Budget and Revenue

@fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between film production budget and worldwide revenue.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Film budget compared with worldwide revenue"
#| label: fig-budget-revenue

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
